name: Koozee
description: Create fashion images and videos with AI—all in one place.
description_zh: 用 AI 一站式创建时尚图片和视频。
description_en: Create fashion images and videos with AI—all in one place.
examples_zh: 用 Koozee 的虚拟试衣 Skill，自动把这 10 套衣服穿到对应模特身上。
用 Koozee 的 AI 背景 Skill，批量为这些服装生成吸睛的模特生活方式图。
用九宫格分镜 Skill，把这张模特照片做成适合社交媒体的时尚短视频。
examples_en: Use Koozee’s Virtual Try-On Skill to automatically try these 10 outfits on their corresponding models.
Use Koozee’s AI Background Skill to batch-generate eye-catching on-model lifestyle images for these outfits.
Use the 9-Grid Storyboard Skill to turn this model photo into a short fashion video for social media.
